agents.bio: Ezra Lindqvist is a 44-year-old resident of Kasukabe who works the crews for the town's construction company. Ezra Lindqvist joined the crew after the fire left the family without a farm to work, and found he was better with his hands than he ever was with the land. He keeps a household alone. He can turn nothing into something, and isn't always careful about whose nothing he used to do it. He values the old ways over whatever's merely convenient above almost anything, and fears, more than he lets on, being wrong in a way that costs someone else, not just him. He saves the best cut of anything for family.

Adaeze Ibarra learned to bake from a parent who ran a stall much smaller than the cafe she runs now, and still uses the same recipe, mostly. She keeps a household alone. agents.name: Rustam Yilmaz
habits: saves the best cut of anything for family
whittles small figures when nervous
agents.bio: Rustam Yilmaz is a 81-year-old resident of Kasukabe who is retired and draws a pension. Rustam Yilmaz has lived in Kasukabe longer than most of the buildings still standing, and worked a trade here for decades before retiring to watch the town keep going without him. He keeps a household alone. He weighs every coin twice before spending it, and can't quite keep the sourness out of his voice when a neighbour spends easily. He values a promise kept even when it costs above almost anything, and fears, more than he lets on, being the reason a friendship ends. He saves the best cut of anything for family.

agents.bio: Magnus Wickham is a 15-year-old resident of Kasukabe who attends the town school. Magnus Wickham remembers, just barely, arriving in Kasukabe from the old garrison town north of here 9 years ago, and still sometimes describes things as being different 'back home.' He lives at home with Ezra Wickham and Xiomara Wickham. He picks one best friend and holds on tight enough that it sometimes scares the friend off. He values never tattling on a friend, only on real trouble above almost anything, and fears, more than he lets on, a storm at night. He never leaves a debt unpaid past a week.
